# JustAI Raises $17M in Series A Funding to Scale AI-Native Marketing Platform

AI-assisted, human-published

JustAI raises $17 million in Series A funding to support the expansion of its AI-native marketing platform for enterprise marketing teams in the US, aiming to revolutionize marketing operations within large enterprises.

JustAI, an AI-native marketing platform, has secured $17 million in Series A funding to support the expansion of its AI-native platform for enterprise marketing teams in the US. The funding round was led by Base10 Partners, with participation from Y Combinator and Peak XV Partners, along with strategic investors and operators from anthropic, Chime, Notion, the CTO of HubSpot, and the founders of Eppo and Vapi.

The platform aims to alleviate the pressure on marketing and growth teams to deliver more output, personalization, and measurable impact without increasing headcount or adding more tools. JustAI experienced 5X growth in annual recurring revenue this year and intends to revolutionize marketing operations within large enterprises

Particle: Reo.Dev Raises $11.3M Series A to Expand U.S. Sales and AI Products

# Reo.Dev Raises $ 11.3M Series A to Expand U.S. Sales and AI Products 

 The startup will use the funds to hire U.S. sales staff and speed development of agent-driven AI that tracks developer activity to surface buying intent. 

## Overview

- Reo.Dev closed an $11.3 million Series A led by Elevation Capital on Thursday, July 16, with participation from Heavybit, India Quotient, Foster Ventures and new backers. 
- The company says it will deploy the capital to build out its U.S. sales and marketing team and accelerate product work on AI agents and related features. 
- Reo.Dev’s core product is a Developer Knowledge Graph that it says contains more than 100 million engineer profiles and tens of billions of signals drawn from public developer platforms. 
- The startup recently introduced an Agent Intent Gateway to capture buying signals generated by AI agents that research software on behalf of users.
